description: This file defines an internal interface ILocalGrainDirectory which provides methods for managing grain directory information in an Orleans runtime environment. It includes methods for starting/stopping directory services, cache management, lookup operations, and testing utilities.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the local portion of the directory service.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the local directory service asynchronously.

methods.name: UnregisterAfterNonexistingActivation
methods.description: Removes the record for a non-existing activation from the directory, used for lazy cleanup or race condition mitigation.

methods.name: LocalLookup
methods.description: Fetches local directory information for a grain, returning true if addresses are complete.

methods.name: InvalidateCacheEntry (GrainAddress)
methods.description: Invalidates cache entry for a specific activation address.

methods.name: InvalidateCacheEntry (GrainId)
methods.description: Invalidates cache entry for a specific grain.

methods.name: AddOrUpdateCacheEntry
methods.description: Adds or updates cache entry for a given grain and silo.

methods.name: GetPrimaryForGrain
methods.description: Returns the silo considered the primary owner of a grain’s directory info.

methods.name: GetLocalDirectoryData
methods.description: Returns directory info held locally for a grain.

methods.name: GetLocalCacheData
methods.description: Returns cached directory info locally for a grain, mainly for testing/troubleshooting.

methods.name: TryCachedLookup
methods.description: Checks if a grain is in the cache and outputs its address if found.

methods.name: IsSiloInCluster
methods.description: Determines if a given silo address is part of the cluster.
